_comment: Plugin issue #3: a markdown image as the alias of a FILE wikilink reads as the image, then the file chip, on both lanes, as fixture 26's wiki embed does. Real Obsidian (1.15.0) caches `[[q.pdf|![](att/img.png)]]` as ONE link and no embed. The q.pdf line pins what plugin 0.2.1 sends: that whole link beside an embed ref the plugin adds for the image. The r.pdf line pins what 0.2.0 sent, the whole link only: the image stays as written and reads as any unlisted markdown image does. Fix round 1 (I1): the split never depends on refs, so a NOTE target (Plan), a target not in the vault (Nope) and a web image read the same way, image then link (or text), on both lanes; the plugin sends no ref for a note link or a web image, only the vault images' own refs.
